info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Human Resource Management By Param1-spec
info.description: The Employee Certification Update API allows for the modification of employee certification records within the Human Resource Management system. Organizations can utilize this API to update specific details related to employee certifications, ensuring that all information is accurate and up-to-date. This operation is typically used by HR personnel and managers who need to maintain compliance and employee records efficiently. By leveraging this endpoint, users can keep track of essential certification statuses and requirements for their workforce.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the certification details of an employee, identified by their unique code. Utilize this endpoint to modify existing certifications, ensuring to provide the necessary data fields accordingly.

requestBody.description: Request body for updating the employee certification details for employee ID EMP-900045. This body must include the fields that need to be updated.

200.description: Request completed successfully; the employee certification has been updated.
